WHAT ARE DEMOCRATS FOR? NOTHING. HERE'S WHAT THEY'RE AGAINST.

I have spent considerable time trying to figure out what the Democrat Party actually stands FOR. Turns out, that's the wrong question. The Democrats are not FOR anything. They are AGAINST everything, including their own stated principles whenever inconvenient. Let me walk you through the mental gymnastics required to be a modern Democrat.

THEY ARE "FOR" WOMEN... UNLESS

Democrats claim to support women. Except when those women are men who identify as women. Then biological men are the BEST women. Lia Thomas, a biological male, can obliterate female swimming records and that's "empowerment." The Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act passed the House 218-206 to protect actual biological girls from unfair competition, and ONLY TWO DEMOCRATS voted for it. Everyone else voted AGAINST protecting women's sports.

But wait, there's more. If a woman is conservative, she's WORSE than a conservative white male. Just look at how they treated Sarah Palin, Amy Coney Barrett, Kristi Noem, or any woman who dares leave the plantation. Susie Wiles became the first female White House Chief of Staff in HISTORY under Trump. Did feminists celebrate? Crickets.

THEY ARE "FOR" BLACK PEOPLE... UNLESS

Democrats claim to be the party of Black Americans. But the moment a Black person votes Republican or thinks for themselves, suddenly they're an "Uncle Tom," a "race traitor," or "not really Black." Remember Biden literally saying "if you have a problem figuring out whether you're for me or Trump, then you ain't Black"?

As Representative Katrina Pearson exposed Jasmine Crockett in that Texas hearing, Democrats claim racism in redistricting while the DEMOCRAT district elected a WHITE MAN (Lloyd Doggett) and the REPUBLICAN district elected a BLACK MAN (Wesley Hunt, a West Point graduate and veteran). The party screaming about racism elected the white guy. The party they call racist elected the Black veteran.

Trump won the MAJORITY of Hispanic voters in Texas and flipped 10 counties. The communities Democrats claim are being "suppressed" are voting Republican. Democrats aren't mad about suppression. They're mad that minorities aren't voting the way Democrats WANT them to vote.

Here's the Democrat formula: All Black people must think alike. All Hispanics must think alike. All women must think alike. Because to Democrats, your skin color determines your thoughts. They've reduced human beings to demographic checkboxes. That's actual racism. That's treating people as a monolith based on immutable characteristics instead of as individuals with free will.

THEY ARE "FOR" FREE SPEECH... UNLESS

Democrats believe in freedom of speech as long as it supports socialism or their leaders. Otherwise, it's "undemocratic speech"... whatever that means. Hate speech is whatever a liberal disagrees with. They will literally call you "Hitler" and "Nazi" for supporting ISRAEL after their enemies attempted another Holocaust-style massacre on October 7th. Let that sink in. They call the people who support JEWS the followers of HITLER. The guy who KILLED Jews. Meanwhile, they side with ACTUAL socialist dictators like Maduro and chant "From the River to the Sea" which explicitly calls for the elimination of the Jewish state. The mental gymnastics required to call Zionists "Nazis" while supporting people who want to finish what Hitler started is Olympic-level cognitive dissonance.

As Quinn's Law #21 states: "Hate speech is any speech a liberal doesn't agree with."

THEY ARE "AGAINST" DICTATORS... EXCEPT

Democrats claim people should never live under a dictator. They call Trump "Hitler" and "dictator" constantly. But let me check the receipts on actual dictator behavior.

First, let's talk about what Democrats are doing RIGHT NOW. They are literally protesting in the streets demanding we RELEASE MADURO and send him back to Venezuela. Let me make sure you understand who Maduro is: He LOST his election and REFUSED TO LEAVE POWER. Sound familiar? That's EXACTLY what Democrats accused Trump of planning to do in 2020. Except Trump DIDN'T do it. Trump had a peaceful transfer of power to Biden despite substantial evidence of election irregularities. Trump left. Maduro DIDN'T.

Maduro took Venezuela from one of the wealthiest countries in South America, sitting on massive oil reserves, to a country where inflation hit 130,000% and thousands of his own people STARVED TO DEATH. Families couldn't feed their children. People ate from garbage. The Venezuelan people have been fleeing by the millions. Thirteen years of brutality, starvation, and oppression.

And Democrats want to PUT HIM BACK IN POWER.

Real Venezuelans are celebrating in the streets worldwide. Madrid, Argentina, Times Square, Miami. People who haven't been able to return home for 13 years are crying tears of joy. But American Democrats? They're holding "Free Maduro" signs and demanding we reinstate the dictator who starved his own people.

So Democrats will call Trump a "dictator" for... what exactly? Mean tweets? While they actively protest to reinstall an ACTUAL dictator who refused to leave power after losing an election and starved families to death. The projection is so thick you could cut it with a knife.

Now let me check the receipts on who actually behaves like dictators:

Who tried to lock up their political opponents? That would be BIDEN'S party. Trump didn't prosecute Hillary despite "Lock her up" chants. But Biden's DOJ indicted Trump four times, raided Mar-a-Lago, and tried to bankrupt him with unprecedented legal theories.

Who sent an armed raid against their political opponent? That would be BIDEN'S party with the FBI raid on Mar-a-Lago.

Who spied on their political opponent's campaign? That would be OBAMA'S party. The Russia hoax started with the Obama administration spying on the Trump campaign. We now have declassified evidence that Obama's people were involved in an operation to subvert Trump's 2016 victory.

Who used the courts to bankrupt their political opponent using laws never before applied? BIDEN'S party. They charged Trump with a misdemeanor past the statute of limitations, bootstrapped it to a felony that should have been federal, and prosecuted it as a state crime in Manhattan where they knew the jury pool was 90% Democrat.

Meanwhile in NYC, illegal immigrants who assaulted police officers were released without bail and given prepaid debit cards.

THEY ARE "FOR" DEMOCRACY... EXCEPT

Here's the kicker. Democrats scream about "saving democracy" while their own party operates like a Soviet politburo.

Look at their last THREE presidential nominees:

2016: Hillary Clinton - Won through superdelegates overriding the will of Bernie Sanders voters. Not elected by actual primary democracy.

2020: Joe Biden - Installed after Obama's kingmakers coordinated to have everyone drop out before Super Tuesday. Jim Clyburn's endorsement was contingent on Biden promising to pick a "Black female" VP. That's not democracy, that's backroom dealing.

2024: Kamala Harris - NEVER WON A SINGLE PRIMARY DELEGATE. She dropped out before Iowa in 2020 because she was so unpopular. Got ZERO votes in the 2024 primary. Was installed when Biden was forced out. Literally the OPPOSITE of democracy.

Democrats keep harping about democracy while using superdelegates to override actual voters. They use superdelegates SPECIFICALLY to prevent grassroots candidates from winning. That's not democracy. That's oligarchy with democratic window dressing.

THEY "BELIEVE" ELECTIONS SHOULD BE SECURE... EXCEPT

Democrats fight against voter ID, claiming Black people and women are too incompetent to obtain a state ID. Think about how racist and sexist that argument actually is. You need ID to buy alcohol, cigarettes, get on a plane, open a bank account, get a job, rent an apartment, buy a car, get a library card, or pick up a prescription. But Democrats think minorities are too dumb to do what literally everyone else does daily.

Meanwhile, what's happening with actual election security?

In Maricopa County, forensic document analysts found approximately 25,000 ballots that were NOT printed from the official Dominion PDF ballot. The printing process showed these were NOT first-generation PDF prints. These ballots showed breaks in all the same places, meaning they came from a copy of a copy rather than the original. That's MORE THAN DOUBLE Biden's 10,457 vote margin.

In Georgia, 315,000 votes were added that had signature verification issues. That's the state Biden won by about 11,000 votes.

The Smartmatic CEO is being held in the Philippines for election interference there. Sydney Powell identified Venezuelan operatives who designed programs to rig election machines. Colorado's Secretary of State had voting machine PASSWORDS posted on a PUBLIC WEBSITE and called it "a mistake."

Democrats sue to PREVENT courts from examining ballots. They sue to PREVENT audits. They fight against chain of custody requirements. They oppose zeroing out voting machines. If elections are so secure, why fight so hard against transparency?

The 2020 Census was plagued with problems affecting accuracy. It overcounted eight states and undercounted six, including Florida and Texas by hundreds of thousands. These errors distorted congressional representation. And this happened under Biden's watch.

THEY ARE "PRO-SCIENCE"... EXCEPT

Democrats claim to follow "the science" unless that science contradicts their policies.

COVID Science: Remember when suggesting COVID came from a lab was "dangerous misinformation"? Now it's the leading theory. Remember when natural immunity didn't count? Now studies confirm it's often superior to vaccine-induced immunity. Remember when masking children was "essential"? Now even the CDC admits cloth masks did virtually nothing.

Transgender Science: The Swedish 30-year follow-up study found that 10-15 years after surgical reassignment, the suicide rate rose to 20 TIMES that of comparable peers. Not a typo. TWENTY TIMES HIGHER. The mortality didn't become apparent until after 10 years post-surgery.

The Branstrom & Pachankis study originally claimed surgery benefits, but was OFFICIALLY CORRECTED by the American Journal of Psychiatry to show "no advantage of surgery" when proper control groups were used. The surgery group had nearly TWICE as many suicide attempts.

Over 90% of post-operative patients are LOST to follow-up in some studies. That's not science. That's willful blindness.

So Democrats believe children can choose life-altering surgery that increases their suicide rate by 20X, but those same children are not mature enough to understand that student LOANS need to be PAID BACK. Make it make sense.

THEY ARE "FOR" THE PEOPLE... EXCEPT CRIMINALS COME FIRST

Democrats are the party of crime. They literally fundraised for BLM rioters during the "Summer of Love" where cities burned, police were attacked, businesses were looted, and people died.

George Floyd died of excited delirium, and while the right called for a fair trial, the left responded by assaulting police officers, burning buildings, and looting Black-owned businesses.

When a CEO was murdered, the left treated the killer like a folk hero. When Trump was shot, they expressed disappointment he survived. When Charlie Kirk was assassinated, Democrats INTERRUPTED the moment of silence in Congress to YELL while Republicans prayed. They're celebrating on TikTok that two young children lost their father.

DC's violent crime rate is 1.5 times higher than NYC's, with a homicide rate 6.5 TIMES higher. If DC were a state, it would have the highest violent and property crime rates in the nation.

Biden granted more acts of clemency than any prior president in history, using an AUTOPEN, including pardoning violent criminals the DOJ marked as "problematic."

Democrats protect illegal alien criminals who've committed child sexual abuse, rape, and murder. They release them. They give them sanctuary. Then they're shocked when those same people reoffend.

THE REAL AGENDA: MODERN SLAVERY

The Democrat Party has ALWAYS needed an underclass to maintain power. In the antebellum South, it was slaves. During Jim Crow, it was segregated Black populations. During the Great Society, they destroyed Black families through welfare programs with marriage penalties.

Look at the numbers: In the 1950s, 80-85% of Black children were in two-parent households, the STRONGEST of any racial group despite discrimination. After Democrat welfare programs? Today fewer than 30% of Black children are in two-parent homes. 77% out-of-wedlock birth rate. The most catastrophic social transformation in American demographic history.

This isn't accidental. Democrats need dependents. They need people who will vote for whoever promises to take more from others and give it to them. Modern welfare is just slavery with extra steps.

When the domestic underclass isn't enough, they import more through open borders, then fight for those illegal immigrants to vote. Same playbook as Jim Crow ballot stuffing, just with different victims.

VENEZUELAN HYPOCRISY: THE FINAL PROOF

Watch Democrats defend MADURO, a socialist murdering dictator, just because Trump captured him. Chris Murphy in 2019 wrote that Maduro had no "democratic legitimacy" and Trump was "right" to push for Venezuelan democracy. Now? He's upset Trump actually DID something about it.

Meanwhile, real Venezuelans are CELEBRATING in the streets worldwide. Madrid, Argentina, Times Square, Miami. People who escaped Maduro's oppression are dancing. And American Democrats are holding "Free Maduro" signs.

Democrats want you to ignore what happened with the 2020 election because they need you ignorant to do it again. They coordinate messaging across platforms with military precision. Quinn's Law #2: "If you want to know what liberals are up to, pay attention to what they accuse conservatives of doing." They accuse Trump of rigging elections while coordinating a "well-funded cabal" (TIME Magazine's words) to "fortify" the 2020 election.

In 1963, Congressman Herlong read 45 Communist Goals into the Congressional Record. Look at how many have been achieved:

Goal #17: "Get control of the schools. Use them as transmission belts for socialism." ACHIEVED.
Goal #24: "Eliminate all laws governing obscenity." ACHIEVED.
Goal #25: "Promote pornography and obscenity." ACHIEVED.
Goal #26: "Present homosexuality, promiscuity as normal." ACHIEVED.
Goal #28: "Eliminate prayer in schools." ACHIEVED.
Goal #40: "Discredit the family as an institution." ACHIEVED.

The long march through the institutions is nearly complete.

Quinn's Law #1: "Liberalism always generates the exact opposite of its stated intent."

They claim to help minorities while creating permanent dependency. They claim to protect women while erasing them. They claim to support free speech while censoring dissent. They claim to defend democracy while installing candidates nobody voted for. They claim to follow science while ignoring inconvenient data.

Democrats aren't FOR anything except power. Everything else is negotiable, disposable, and subject to change the moment it becomes politically inconvenient.

But what do I know? I'm just someone who actually reads the research, studies the history, and refuses to accept that 2+2=5 because the Party says so.
